verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a 401(k) offering via its Guideline integration, with partner-facing pre-built flows letting employer admins access Guideline through Gusto Embedded, and lists 401(k)/Guideline among supported benefit integrations. However, the docs describe only account-access/onboarding flows, not the specifics of automatic contribution syncing with each payroll run, and one community anecdote (gusto-comm-16) references friction when being 'pulled back into Gusto' from Guideline, suggesting the integration experience isn't seamless for all users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the payroll-to-401(k) contribution sync mechanism/frequency, and independent confirmation that contributions flow automatically each pay cycle without manual intervention.
